svg.title: Classic Rose — layered cut sheet
svg.desc: Bloom 62 mm across · stem 200 mm. Roll the spiral centre onto 18ga wire. Cup each petal over a thumb, glue outer ring first (offset joins), then mid, then inner, then the spiral centre into the cup. Wrap the 5-point calyx under the bloom and tape in the leaves.
